_comment: Example handoff payload: IEC 61850 adapter normalized request for a READ intent (source operation: read of data attribute 'mag' on data object 'TotW' in logical node 'MMXU1', functional constraint MX, on logical device 'MEAS' of IED 'ied-sub1'). Produced by Iec61850Adapter.normalize() and serialized via NormalizedAuthorizationRequest.to_dict(). The IED/logical device/logical node/data object/data attribute identity, functional constraint, quality, and timestamp stay in protocol_evidence — never as top-level fields. This is a handoff artifact — not a decision, not enforcement, not authentication, and not live IEC 61850 communication.
